source:
This is the first letter from home that I had received in a while.

"One of four has prepared, just for you:
a table with four chairs,
four cups and a pot full of tea.
Not to be forgotten are the four pastries,
each of them a different kind.
Please, don't forget that
we are awaiting your arrival."

One of them is a liar,
another - his accomplice.
The third one is me,
the fourth one - you.

I have departed for my hometown.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/4952]Freem![/url]]
translation:
这是我隔了好一阵子才收到的第一封家书。

“四人中的一人已为你备好一张桌子，上面摆着四把椅子、四只杯子和一壶茶。别忘了，还有四种各不相同的点心。请不要忘记，我们都在等你回来。”

四人中的一人是骗子，另一人是他的同伙。第三个人是我，第四个人是你。

我已经启程回故乡。[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/4952]Freem![/url]]
